text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, everyone! Lend me your ears while you eat.
As announced, we have an evacuation drill today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This training is practical-oriented so you can get used to performing under pressure.
Everyone, stay focused! Got it?

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
(Ding-dong-dang-dong)
"This is a drill."

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"An Earthquake Early Warning has been issued.
This is a drill. Please evacuate immediately."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And so it begins.
Shall we make our evacuation?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Don't forget your foldable helmet.

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Mother
text_block_list.text:
Believe-chan and Lala-chan, you're the first ones here.
Hey, could I ask you to confirm this floor's evacuation?
I'd like you to check the rooms and make sure no one is left behind.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
So I just need to confirm that all rooms are evacuated.
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Right then, Believe-san.
Let's split up between east and west to cover ground.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Is anyone here?!
...Nobody. Alright.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—The next room is the last one.
Once we're done there, let's check everything together.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
There's no one here.
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Believe & Lala
text_block_list.text:
!
Eek!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's going on...? 
A blackout...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clang! Vrrrroooom...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
What was that sound just now...?
Oh! There's light leaking from the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...It looks like the lights in the common area are on.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It probably switched over to the emergency power supply.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ! Wh-What... You've gotta be kidding me!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The front door...
won't open anymore...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Are we... locked in? Is there trouble?
What is going on...?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If there is trouble, it is best not to act rashly.
First, let us assess the situation accurately.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Roll call is scheduled after leaving the dorms. The fact that nobody has come looking for us means... this isn't an unforeseen incident. It could be part of our training.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...
So will it be all right, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I need to check in and let them know I'm safe.
I'll send a message to Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll... Oh, I know!
I'll go grab the disaster prep supplies from the storeroom!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...It has already been two hours since then, hasn't it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Still no reply from Trainer? Should we try sending another message?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange that there's been no word for this long.
Perhaps something unexpected happened outside,
and they're dealing with a far more pressing crisis...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, we're uninjured.
The urgency for rescue is low.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Let's conserve our energy in case the evacuation is prolonged and wait to hear from them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The evacuation drill was coming to an end.
Practical exercises like the earthquake simulator and fire extinguisher training proved to be immensely valuable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...There is one thing on my mind, though.
A strange text from Believe
that I just noticed on my phone."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Believe and Lucky Lilac are safe."
...Safe? Why would they report that?
choice_data_list: Ah, Fuji Kiseki. Got a minute?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, that is strange.
Everyone in the Ritto dorm should have been present at roll call, but...
I'll check again.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! There was a mix-up during roll call.
Believe and Lara aren't here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed to the Ritto Dormitory with Fuji Kiseki.
If they sent a safety check-in, that means
something must have happened to the two of them!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
! The entrance is locked?!
Then the two of them are trapped in the dorm—!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Believe, Lala! Thank goodness...
Are you feeling all right?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes... So does that mean there was some trouble?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was an accident. Sorry I didn't notice sooner.
Yeah, it was an accident. Sorry I didn't notice sooner.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
We just moved like we were evacuating, so we managed to pull through.
It's all thanks to Believe-san keeping her cool.
choice_data_list: I'm just so glad you're safe!
There's such a thing as being too patient...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Since everything was fine, I assumed there'd be no issue...
From now on, regardless of the situation, I will keep you thoroughly updated.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I will try not to make you worry.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if there was trouble outside as well.
It wasn't an urgent situation for us, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "No, no, you don't need to hold back—it's okay to ask for help..."
choice_data_list: (I need to keep a close eye on her...)
(I need to keep a close eye on her...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quietly make a resolution.
Her threshold for endurance is so high that she might just push past the pain without speaking up—
